description: Building AstroHabitat: an interactive concept for sustainable human habitats on the Moon and Mars. We combine biotechnology, AI, software development, and space exploration to imagine the future of human life beyond Earth. Looking for passionate collaborators interested in coding, AI/ML, biology, engineering, space science, UI/UX, and data visualization. Let's innovate together!
summary:
# ASTROHABIT – Mars Science & Outpost Trainer

**ASTROHABIT** is an interactive Mars exploration and science-training simulator developed using Godot 4.7.2.

The prototype features a driveable Perseverance rover, rover probe animation, a Martian surface environment, and an interactive MEDA science console.

It incorporates archived NASA Mars 2020 MEDA Atmospheric Temperature Sensor (ATS) observations from Sol 1, allowing users to explore temperature measurements across five sensor channels and switch between Kelvin and Celsius.

**NASA data source:** Mars 2020 Perseverance MEDA calibrated atmospheric temperature observations, Sol 1, from NASA's Planetary Data System.

**Technology:** Godot 4.7.2, GDScript, 3D simulation, NASA PDS data.

**Current status:** Working prototype. Further development will improve terrain realism, rover mobility and scientific interactions.

**Goal:** Make Mars surface exploration and atmospheric science more accessible through interactive simulation.
details:
ASTROHABIT is an interactive Mars exploration and science-training simulator built using Godot 4.7.2.

The prototype features a driveable NASA Perseverance-inspired rover model, keyboard-based movement, a rover probe animation, and an interactive MEDA science console.

The science console uses actual archived Mars 2020 MEDA Atmospheric Temperature Sensor (ATS) observations from Sol 1. Users can explore five temperature sensor channels, inspect their measurements, and switch between Kelvin and Celsius.

The project aims to make planetary exploration and atmospheric science accessible through an interactive 3D learning environment.

Technology used: Godot 4.7.2, GDScript, 3D simulation, and NASA Planetary Data System observations.

Future development will expand the Martian terrain, rover navigation, scientific experiments, and outpost simulation capabilities.
